# Kinetic3D — Digital 3D Fabrication Platform & Custom Workshop

> Kinetic3D is the leading Vietnamese on-demand additive manufacturing platform and futuristic 3D e-commerce ecosystem. It fuses automated multi-material 3D printing (Bambu AMS / SLA Resin), real-time 3D WebGL interactive visualization (Three.js), an AI-driven image-to-3D generator, and automated VietQR banking reconciliation powered by Casso.

## Primary Entity Information
- **Name:** Kinetic3D
- **Legal Entity:** Kinetic Technologies Vietnam Co., Ltd.
- **Industry:** Additive Manufacturing, Rapid Prototyping, 3D E-commerce, Generative 3D AI
- **Headquarters:** High-Tech Park, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Contact:** Hotline: 0988.888.888 | Email: contact@kinetic3d.vn
- **Official Website:** https://kinetic3d.vn

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **AMS Multi-Color 3D Printing:** Industrial-grade multi-filament FDM and SLA resin manufacturing supporting up to 8 simultaneous colors, ideal for mechanical assemblies, anime figurines, and functional prototypes.
- **AI Image-to-3D Studio:** Generates watertight, game-ready quad meshes (500 to 2M polygons) with complete PBR textures directly from 2D photos or text prompts.
- **On-Demand Custom Fabrication:** Instant volume calculation, slicer preview, and real-time quoting for custom STL, OBJ, 3MF, and STEP uploads.
- **Precision Engineered Catalog:** Ready-to-ship cyber-tech EDC items, high-performance charging docks, artisan mechanical keycaps, and desktop display pieces.
- **Live Production Telemetry:** Real-time 5-stage tracking of slicing, printing, and shipping status via order numbers (`KN3D-yyyyMMdd-XXXXXX`) or phone numbers.

## Pricing & Membership Tiers
- **Free Starter (0₫/lifetime):** 50 starter credits, 60-120 FPS WebGL viewer, standard queue.
- **Pro Workshop (199.000₫/month or 165.000₫/month annually):** 500 AI credits/month, unlimited STL/GLB downloads, quad retopology, AMS multi-color printing unlocked.
- **Studio Enterprise (890.000₫/month):** Unlimited AI generation, dedicated 1-on-1 CAD engineer support, aerospace materials (Carbon Fiber, PEEK, dental resin), electronic VAT invoicing.

## Payment & Fulfillment Protocols
- **Automated VietQR:** Instant 24/7 bank transfer matching via Casso (Timo STK 9021597313131, recipient: DO PHU KHUONG). Orders automatically trigger workshop 3D print queues and Telegram alerts upon payment receipt.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Nationwide delivery with full unboxing inspection rights (đồng kiểm).
- **Turnaround Times:** Printing in 12-36 hours. Delivery within 24 hours for Hanoi & Ho Chi Minh City; 48-72 hours nationwide via express courier.
- **Warranty & Quality Guarantee:** 100% free reprint or full refund within 7 days if dimensional deviation exceeds ±0.25mm or in case of transit breakage.

## Technical Tolerances & Specifications
- **FDM Layer Height:** 0.08mm – 0.28mm (±0.1mm standard mechanical tolerance)
- **SLA Resin Resolution:** 0.02mm layer height (19 micron optical resolution)
- **Approved Filaments:** PLA+ Matte, PETG Tough, TPU 95A Flexible, ABS-GF, Carbon Fiber Polycarbonate, 12K Water-Washable Resin.
- **Supported 3D Formats:** STL, OBJ, GLB, 3MF, STEP, FBX.
